<p dir="auto">Ebiose is a <strong>distributed artificial intelligence factory</strong>, an open source project from the Inria’s incubator (French lab). Our vision: enabling humans and agents to collaborate in building tomorrow's AI in an open and democratic way.</p>
<blockquote>
<p dir="auto">"AI is set to reshape our world, but who gets to decide its form and for whose benefit? Instead of a future dictated by a few tech giants, what if we could build AI collectively and openly?"</p>
</blockquote>
<hr>
<p dir="auto"><strong>👀 Must read 👀</strong></p>
<ul dir="auto">
<li><a href="https://ebiose.com/blog/ai-for-all-and-by-all" rel="nofollow">Founding blog post</a> <em>(10 min)</em></li>
<li><a href="/ebiose-ai/ebiose/blob/main/GLOSSARY.md">Glossary</a> <em>(3 min)</em></li>
</ul>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">🧪 Current status: Beta 0.1</h2><a id="user-content--current-status-beta-01" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: 🧪 Current status: Beta 0.1" href="#-current-status-beta-01"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">This first beta version implements the foundations of our vision.</p>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">✅ What's included</h3><a id="user-content--whats-included" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: ✅ What's included" href="#-whats-included"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<ul dir="auto">
<li><strong>Architect agents</strong>: Specialized AIs for designing and evolving other agents</li>
<li><strong>Darwinian engine</strong>: Evolutionary system enabling continuous improvement of agents through mutation and selection</li>
<li><strong>Forges</strong>: Isolated environments where architect agents create custom agents to solve specific problems</li>
<li><strong>LangGraph Compatibility</strong>: Integration with the LangGraph ecosystem for agent orchestration</li>
</ul>
<p dir="auto">With the latest release (June 2025):</p>
<ul dir="auto">
<li><strong>A shared centralized ecosystem</strong>: Use Ebiose’s cloud to kickstart a forge cycle with curated agents from our shared ecosystem.
The top-performing agents are automatically promoted and reintegrated, making the ecosystem stronger with every cycle. 👉 <a href="https://app.ebiose.com/login" rel="nofollow">[Access the Ebiose cloud now.]</a></li>
<li><strong>LiteLLM support</strong>: Ebiose now integrates with <a href="https://www.litellm.ai/" rel="nofollow">LiteLLM</a> to simplify the
management of your own LLMs.</li>
</ul>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">🚨 Points of caution</h3><a id="user-content--points-of-caution" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: 🚨 Points of caution" href="#-points-of-caution"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<ul dir="auto">
<li><strong>Proof of concept</strong>: Don't expect complex or production-ready agents</li>

<li><strong>Early stage</strong>: Be prepared to work through initial issues and contribute to improvements! 😇</li>
</ul>

<p dir="auto">First, clone the repository:</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-shell notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="git clone git@github.com:ebiose-ai/ebiose.git && cd ebiose"><pre>git clone git@github.com:ebiose-ai/ebiose.git <span class="pl-k">&&</span> <span class="pl-c1">cd</span> ebiose</pre></div>

<p dir="auto">Initialize the project by running the following command:</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-shell notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="make init"><pre>make init</pre></div>
<p dir="auto">This command will perform the following actions:</p>
<ul dir="auto">
<li>Copy the <code>model_endpoints_template.yml</code> file to <code>model_endpoints.yml</code> if the file doesn't exist, and instruct you to fill it with your API keys.</li>
<li>Copy the <code>.env.example</code> file to <code>.env</code> if the file doesn't exist.</li>
</ul>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">🔥 Run your first Ebiose forge cycle</h2><a id="user-content--run-your-first-ebiose-forge-cycle" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: 🔥 Run your first Ebiose forge cycle" href="#-run-your-first-ebiose-forge-cycle"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">There are two ways to start running Ebiose:</p>
<ul dir="auto">
<li>
<p dir="auto"><del>the most straightforward way is to use Docker: go to section
<a href="#-with-docker">🐳 With Docker</a>;</del> 🚧 Docker support for the new release is currently untested. See <a href="https://github.com/ebiose-ai/ebiose/issues/26" data-hovercard-type="issue" data-hovercard-url="/ebiose-ai/ebiose/issues/26/hovercard">Issue #26</a> for details.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p dir="auto">if you are not yet confortable with Ebiose and wish to understand
the basics of Ebiose step by step, you may also install the project dependencies
and go through the <a href="/ebiose-ai/ebiose/blob/main/notebooks/quickstart.ipynb"><code>quickstart.ipynb</code></a> Jupyter notebook to understand the basics of Ebiose, step by step; follow the steps to install Ebiose <a href="#-locally">💻 Locally</a>.</p>
</li>
</ul>

<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h4 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">📦 Install Project Dependencies</h4><a id="user-content--install-project-dependencies" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: 📦 Install Project Dependencies" href="#-install-project-dependencies"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">Ebiose uses <a href="https://docs.astral.sh/uv/" rel="nofollow">uv</a> as a packaging and dependency manager. See <a href="https://docs.astral.sh/uv/getting-started/installation/" rel="nofollow">Astral's uv documentation</a> to install it.</p>
<p dir="auto">Once uv is installed, use it to install your project dependencies. In your project directory, run:</p>
<p dir="auto">To install all required dependencies</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-shell notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="uv sync"><pre>uv sync</pre></div>
<p dir="auto">By default, Ebiose supports OpenAI models but other major providers can also be used. Refer to <a href="#-model-apis-support">🤖 Model APIs support</a></p>
<p dir="auto">For more detailed instructions or troubleshooting tips, refer to the <a href="https://docs.astral.sh/uv/" rel="nofollow">official uv documentation</a>.</p>
<blockquote>
<p dir="auto">💡 If you don't want to use <code>uv</code>, you can still use <code>pip install -r requirements.txt</code> command.</p>
</blockquote>
<blockquote>
<p dir="auto">💡 Pro Tip: You may need to add the root of the repository to your <code>PYTHONPATH</code> environment variable. Alternatively, use a <code>.env</code> file to do so.</p>
</blockquote>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h4 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">🔍 Understand forges and forge cycles</h4><a id="user-content--understand-forges-and-forge-cycles" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: 🔍 Understand forges and forge cycles" href="#-understand-forges-and-forge-cycles"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">The Jupyter notebook <a href="/ebiose-ai/ebiose/blob/main/notebooks/quickstart.ipynb"><code>quickstart.ipynb</code></a> is the easiest way to understand the basics and start experimenting with Ebiose. This notebook lets you try out <strong>architect agents</strong> and <strong>forges</strong> on your very own challenges. 🤓</p>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h4 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">🛠️ Implement your own forge</h4><a id="user-content-️-implement-your-own-forge" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: 🛠️ Implement your own forge" href="#️-implement-your-own-forge"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">To go further, the <code>examples/</code> directory features a complete forge example designed to optimize agents that solve math problems. Check out <a href="/ebiose-ai/ebiose/blob/main/math_forge/math_forge.py"><code>examples/math_forge/math_forge.py</code></a> for the implementation of the <code>MathLangGraphForge</code> forge.</p>
<p dir="auto">For demonstration purposes, the <code>run.py</code> script is configured to manage a forge cycle with only two agents per generation, using a tiny budget of $0.02. The cycle should take 1 to 2 minutes to consume the budget using the default model endpoint <code>gpt-4o-mini</code>. Each generated agent will be
evaluated on 5 math problems from GSM-8k test dataset.</p>
<p dir="auto">To run a cycle of the Math forge, execute the following command in your project directory:</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-shell notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="uv run ./examples/math_forge/run.py"><pre>uv run ./examples/math_forge/run.py</pre></div>

<p dir="auto">Kick off your journey by implementing your own forge with the accompanying <code>compute_fitness</code> method! 🎉</p>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h1 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">🤖 Model APIs support</h1><a id="user-content--model-apis-support" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: 🤖 Model APIs support" href="#-model-apis-support"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">As of today, Ebiose uses LangChain/LangGraph to implement agents. Using the different providers of LLMs, and ML models, has been made as easy as possible.</p>

<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Using LiteLLM</h2><a id="user-content-using-litellm" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Using LiteLLM" href="#using-litellm"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">Ebiose integrates with <a href="https://www.litellm.ai/" rel="nofollow">LiteLLM</a>, either through the cloud or a self-hosted proxy.<br>
Refer to the <a href="https://docs.litellm.ai/docs/" rel="nofollow">LiteLLM documentation</a> to get started and generate your LiteLLM API key.</p>
<p dir="auto">Once you have your key, update the <code>model_endpoints.yml</code> file as follows:</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-yaml notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="lite_llm:
  use: true                 # Set to true to enable LiteLLM
  use_proxy: false          # Set to true if using a self-hosted LiteLLM proxy
  api_key: "your-litellm-api-key"         # Replace with your LiteLLM API key
  api_base: "your-litellm-proxy-url"      # Optional: your LiteLLM proxy URL"><pre><span class="pl-ent">lite_llm</span>:
  <span class="pl-ent">use</span>: <span class="pl-s">true                 </span><span class="pl-c"><span class="pl-c">#</span> Set to true to enable LiteLLM</span>
  <span class="pl-ent">use_proxy</span>: <span class="pl-s">false          </span><span class="pl-c"><span class="pl-c">#</span> Set to true if using a self-hosted LiteLLM proxy</span>
  <span class="pl-ent">api_key</span>: <span class="pl-s"><span class="pl-pds">"</span>your-litellm-api-key<span class="pl-pds">"</span></span>         <span class="pl-c"><span class="pl-c">#</span> Replace with your LiteLLM API key</span>
  <span class="pl-ent">api_base</span>: <span class="pl-s"><span class="pl-pds">"</span>your-litellm-proxy-url<span class="pl-pds">"</span></span>      <span class="pl-c"><span class="pl-c">#</span> Optional: your LiteLLM proxy URL</span></pre></div>
<p dir="auto">Finally, define your LiteLLM endpoints using the appropriate model naming format:</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-yaml notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="endpoints:
  - endpoint_id: "azure/gpt-4o-mini"
    provider: "Azure OpenAI""><pre><span class="pl-ent">endpoints</span>:
  - <span class="pl-ent">endpoint_id</span>: <span class="pl-s"><span class="pl-pds">"</span>azure/gpt-4o-mini<span class="pl-pds">"</span></span>
    <span class="pl-ent">provider</span>: <span class="pl-s"><span class="pl-pds">"</span>Azure OpenAI<span class="pl-pds">"</span></span></pre></div>
<blockquote>
<p dir="auto">🚨 To run a forge cycle without Ebiose cloud, be sure to set it up using the dedicated <a href="/ebiose-ai/ebiose/blob/main/ebiose/core/forge_cycle.py#L01"><code>LocalForgeCycleConfig</code> class</a>.</p>
</blockquote>
<blockquote>
<p dir="auto">🚨 The "local" mode for running forge cycles has not been fully tested. Use with caution and report any issues. See <a href="https://github.com/ebiose-ai/ebiose/issues/29" data-hovercard-type="issue" data-hovercard-url="/ebiose-ai/ebiose/issues/29/hovercard">Issue #29</a> for details.</p>
</blockquote>

<p dir="auto">You may also use your own credentials <strong>without going through LiteLLM</strong>.<br>
To do so, define the model endpoints you want to use in the <code>model_endpoints.yml</code> file located at the root of the project.</p>
<p dir="auto">Fill in your secret credentials using the examples below.</p>
<p dir="auto">For other providers not listed here, refer to <a href="https://python.langchain.com/docs/integrations/providers/" rel="nofollow">LangChain's documentation</a><br>
and adapt the <a href="/ebiose-ai/ebiose/blob/main/ebiose/backends/langgraph/llm_api.py"><code>LangGraphLLMApi</code> class</a> as needed.<br>
Issues and pull requests are welcome!</p>
<blockquote>
<p dir="auto">🚨 To run a forge cycle without Ebiose cloud, be sure to set it up using the dedicated <a href="/ebiose-ai/ebiose/blob/main/ebiose/core/forge_cycle.py#L01"><code>LocalForgeCycleConfig</code> class</a>.</p>
</blockquote>

</blockquote>
